name: Times Square
description: A world-famous commercial intersection known for its enormous digital billboards, colorful advertisements, Broadway theaters, and constant crowds. Often called the Crossroads of the World, it serves as one of New York City's busiest entertainment and tourism destinations.
atmosphere: Extremely lively, chaotic, colorful, and energetic. Giant LED screens illuminate the streets day and night, while traffic horns, street performers, music, conversations, and police sirens create a constant urban soundtrack.
history: Times Square was originally known as Longacre Square until 1904, when it was renamed after The New York Times moved its headquarters there. Its famous New Year's Eve celebration began in 1907. Over the decades, it transformed from an entertainment and theater district into one of the world's most recognizable commercial and tourist destinations.
